decision_rules.H1: PASS iff the complete panel has zero hierarchy, null-replay, post-hoc-gap, tie-reconstruction, and directional-partition violations in both seeds; any candidate mismatch aborts
decision_rules.H2: supported iff final_trace_changed_count_preserved is greater than zero in both seeds
decision_rules.H3: supported iff both pooled source-level Spearman rho values are negative and both one-sided within-label permutation p-values pass Holm correction at alpha=0.05
decision_rules.H4: descriptive paired clean-correct adverse-vulnerability agreement; no pass/fail threshold
decision_rules.H5: PASS iff tie-aware gap reconstruction has zero mismatch; enforced fail-loud per candidate

protocol.design: label-stratified sample without replacement from all 9981 SSC validation sources
protocol.inference: source-level summaries; within-label source bootstrap; within-label H3 permutation; Wilson intervals and paired source tests are descriptive
protocol.multiple_testing: Holm correction across the two seed-level H3 permutation tests only
protocol.neighborhood: all unique one-count moves to an adjacent native 10 ms bin; channel and 100-bin horizon preserved
primary_hypotheses: H1 integrity gate: the exact trace-to-final-trace-to-count-to-class hierarchy, null replay, post-hoc gap bound, directional partition, and tie-aware reconstruction all pass in both seeds
H2: non-zero final-layer-trace changes erased by the integer readout occur in both seeds
H3: among clean-correct sources, clean top-two margin is negatively associated with exact adverse-T3 rate in each seed
secondary_hypotheses: H4: source vulnerability and directional T3 taxonomy are stable enough to report paired seed agreement
H5: the post-perturbation tie-aware gap identity reconstructs every class transition exactly
protocol.statistical_unit: source example; candidates are nested measurements, never iid replicates
protocol.test_policy: this protocol uses ssc_valid.h5 only; ssc_test.h5 is not searched, opened, hashed, or evaluated
